donationText: For a few dollars more the adapter will not run faster, but the developer may type with much better coffee. PayPal placeholder for optional support.
paypalDonationUrlHelp: Optional PayPal link. For the first version this is only a placeholder in the configuration.
clientIdHelp: The Client ID comes from the Viessmann Developer Portal. The adapter uses it for OAuth PKCE: clicking the Viessmann sign-in button creates a login URL, Viessmann redirects back to the adapter callback URI after login, and the adapter stores/refreshes the tokens afterwards. The callback URI must be registered exactly in the Viessmann client.
redirectUriHelp: Fallback/manual redirect URI. For automatic login use the public adapter callback URI below.
scopeHelp: The scope is fixed for this adapter and is used for Viessmann OAuth.
oauthPublicRedirectUriHelp: Must be registered in the Viessmann developer application. The browser must be able to reach this URI.
oauthOpenHint: Only needed during initial setup: after clicking sign in, complete the Viessmann login. The adapter receives the OAuth callback automatically and refreshes tokens itself afterwards.
oauthLoginUrlHelp: Open this URL in the browser. After login, paste the complete callback URL or only the code below.
oauthCodeHelp: Paste the complete callback URL from the browser or only the code parameter.
pollIntervalHelp: Minimum is 2 minutes. For normal operation, 5 minutes or more is recommended to preserve API budget for writes.
dailyRequestBudgetHelp: Upper limit used for local 24 hour budget estimation.
writeAllowlistHint: Dynamically discovered write endpoints are listed under writes.discovered. Enable each endpoint under writes.allowlist.<feature>.<command>.enabled. The matching control state appears only afterwards.
supportReportHint: Creates a redacted support report under diagnostics.support.report. Tokens, client secret and concrete gateway/installation IDs are not included.
